scripts.build: node scripts/sync-client-assets.mjs && node scripts/prepare-ocr.mjs && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.test:ui: node --test tests/search-presentation.test.mjs tests/ocr-client.test.mjs tests/appearance.test.mjs tests/variable-rows.test.mjs tests/date-time.test.mjs
scripts.prepare:miniprogram: node scripts/sync-client-assets.mjs && node scripts/build-miniprogram-vendor.mjs && node tools/mobile-index/build.mjs
scripts.check:miniprogram: node scripts/sync-client-assets.mjs --check && node scripts/build-miniprogram-vendor.mjs --check && node tools/mobile-index/build.mjs --check && tsc --noEmit -p miniprogram/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:self-host: pnpm build:self-host && node --test tests/self-host.test.mjs tests/cloud-auth.test.mjs tests/cloud-workflow.test.mjs tests/password-maintainer.test.mjs
